metadata.title: Osimertinib Monotherapy
metadata.indication: EGFR-mutated NSCLC, including T790M-positive advanced disease, first-line metastatic and adjuvant treatment.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

limitations: NCCP severe hepatic 50% consideration conflicts with current EMA severe-hepatic recommendation; no automatic dose.
NCCP CTCAE v4.0 retained; EMA table now names v5.0.
Post-chemoradiation LAURA and FLAURA2 combination indications are not listed NCCP00353 v5 indications.

metadata.schedule_summary: The usual starting dose is 80 mg by mouth once daily, every day without a planned rest week. Use the dose on your prescription. Advanced treatment continues while helping and tolerated; adjuvant treatment is planned for up to three years, with earlier stopping if cancer returns or side effects become unacceptable.

indications.description: Adults with locally advanced or metastatic EGFR T790M mutation-positive NSCLC.
First-line treatment of adults with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with activating EGFR mutations.
Adjuvant monotherapy after complete resection of stage IB–IIIA NSCLC with EGFR exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R substitution.

treatment.schedule_summary: Osimertinib 80 mg orally once daily continuously. Advanced disease: until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Adjuvant: up to three years; longer treatment was not studied.
administration_instructions: With or without food, at the same time each day. Swallow whole; do not crush, split or chew.
If missed, take when remembered unless less than 12 hours until the next dose; then skip. Confirm the individual instruction at the 12-hour boundary.
For swallowing difficulty use the source water-dispersion method; nasogastric administration requires pharmacy/tube-specific instructions.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST results (actual values entered; highest ×ULN calculated automatically)
alt_ast_uln_multiple.assessment_guidance: Interpret with baseline, trend, symptoms and the full hepatic assessment. An isolated result does not establish severe hepatic impairment or a source-defined toxicity grade.

bilirubin_uln_multiple.label: Bilirubin result (actual value entered; ×ULN calculated automatically)
bilirubin_uln_multiple.assessment_guidance: Interpret with baseline, trend, symptoms and the full hepatic assessment. An isolated result does not establish severe hepatic impairment or a source-defined toxicity grade.

lvef_change.label: LVEF decline or relevant cardiac signs/symptoms
lvef_change.assessment_guidance: NCCP and EMA require consideration of cardiac/LVEF assessment. They do not specify an automatic percentage reduction or universal numerical stopping cutoff for monotherapy.

targeted_renal_band.label: Renal function for this targeted therapy
targeted_renal_band.assessment_guidance: Legacy non_dialysis means only no dialysis; it must not imply normal renal function. SmPC evidence is not established below CrCl 15 or on dialysis.

targeted_hepatic_band.label: Hepatic function for this targeted therapy

options.label: None, mild or moderate / Child A-B

targeted_hepatic_band.assessment_guidance: Use clinical severe hepatic / Child-Pugh C classification. NCCP allows consideration of 50% whereas EMA advises against severe-hepatic use; consultant/pharmacy reconciliation is required.

egfr_validated_positive.label: Relevant EGFR mutation confirmed using validated testing
egfr_validated_positive.assessment_guidance: For 00353a confirm T790M; for 00353b activating EGFR; for 00353c resected tissue Ex19del/L858R.

adjuvant_complete_resection_stage_mutati.label: Adjuvant complete resection, stage IB–IIIA and Ex19del/L858R confirmed
adjuvant_complete_resection_stage_mutati.assessment_guidance: All three criteria are needed; this is not unresectable stage III post-chemoradiation.

adjuvant_chemotherapy.label: Adjuvant platinum-doublet chemotherapy prescribed
adjuvant_chemotherapy.assessment_guidance: Source maximum four cycles; complete chemotherapy before osimertinib.

adjuvant_chemotherapy_completed.label: Adjuvant chemotherapy completed
adjuvant_chemotherapy_completed.assessment_guidance: At least two and no more than ten weeks since last dose.

adjuvant_exclusion_present.label: Adjuvant exclusion: neoadjuvant chemotherapy, neoadjuvant/adjuvant radiation or previous EGFR inhibitor
adjuvant_exclusion_present.assessment_guidance: These are NCCP00353 v5 adjuvant exclusions; a newer licence does not remove them from this protocol.

ild_suspected.label: New unexplained respiratory symptoms / suspected ILD
ild_suspected.assessment_guidance: Interrupt pending investigation; grade alone does not confirm drug-induced ILD.

ild_confirmed.label: ILD / pneumonitis confirmed
ild_confirmed.assessment_guidance: NCCP permanently discontinues confirmed ILD; not a grading-dependent rule.

scar_suspected.label: Suspected Stevens–Johnson syndrome / toxic epidermal necrolysis
scar_suspected.assessment_guidance: Blistering, peeling or mucosal involvement requires urgent assessment.

scar_confirmed.label: Stevens–Johnson syndrome / toxic epidermal necrolysis confirmed

aplastic_anaemia_suspected.label: Suspected aplastic anaemia
aplastic_anaemia_suspected.assessment_guidance: Persistent fever, bruising, bleeding, pallor, infection or fatigue: urgent blood-count review.

qtc_second_ecg_gt500.label: QTc >500 ms confirmed on at least two separate ECGs
qtc_second_ecg_gt500.assessment_guidance: The confirmation is independent of a single entered QTc value; a discordant latest value must not erase the episode.

qtc_serious_arrhythmia.label: QTc prolongation with serious arrhythmia signs/symptoms
qtc_serious_arrhythmia.assessment_guidance: Includes torsade de pointes or polymorphic ventricular tachycardia.

qtc_hold_episode.label: Previously held for QTc >500 ms on two ECGs
qtc_hold_episode.assessment_guidance: Use recovery fields only with this documented episode.

qtc_recovered_to_baseline.label: QTc has recovered to its documented baseline
qtc_recovered_to_baseline.assessment_guidance: Only the baseline ≥481 ms alternative pathway uses this assessment.

grade3_episode_held.label: Treatment held for a grade 3 or higher other adverse reaction
grade3_episode_held.assessment_guidance: This excludes the separate ILD, QTc, SJS/TEN and aplastic-anaemia pathways.

toxicity_recovered_grade0_2.label: Previous grade ≥3 other reaction has recovered to grade 0–2
toxicity_recovered_grade0_2.assessment_guidance: Use clinician-assigned NCCP CTCAE v4.0 grade.

strong_cyp3a_inducer.label: Strong CYP3A inducer present
strong_cyp3a_inducer.assessment_guidance: Avoid concurrent strong inducers; do not auto-escalate osimertinib.

qtc_prolonging_medicine.label: Other QT-prolonging medicine or electrolyte risk
qtc_prolonging_medicine.assessment_guidance: Review medicines, electrolytes and ECG; do not add a QT-prolonging antiemetic automatically.

keratitis_symptoms.label: New eye pain, light sensitivity, red eye or blurred vision

severe_renal_impairment.label: Clinically assessed severe renal impairment
severe_renal_impairment.assessment_guidance: Current SmPC cautions even though it does not require a routine dose adjustment.

toxicity_hold_days.label: Days held for previous grade ≥3 other adverse reaction

renal_input.reason: Identifies SmPC end-stage evidence gap below 15 mL/min; no Calvert calculation or dose formula.

rules.explanation: NCCP eligibility is ECOG 0–1; ECOG 2 or greater needs explicit Consultant assessment.

rules.explanation: Do not administer with hypersensitivity to osimertinib or its excipients.

rules.explanation: NCCP excludes congenital long QT syndrome.

action.message: Validated, indication-appropriate EGFR positivity must be established before treatment. A negative plasma result may require tissue testing.

rules.explanation: Validated, indication-appropriate EGFR positivity must be established before treatment. A negative plasma result may require tissue testing.

action.message: 00353a requires validated EGFR T790M positivity.

rules.explanation: 00353a requires validated EGFR T790M positivity.

action.message: Confirm complete resection, stage IB–IIIA and tumour Ex19del/L858R before using the adjuvant indication.

rules.explanation: Confirm complete resection, stage IB–IIIA and tumour Ex19del/L858R before using the adjuvant indication.

action.message: NCCP adjuvant pathway excludes neoadjuvant chemotherapy, neoadjuvant/adjuvant radiation and prior EGFR inhibitor therapy; specialist protocol review is required.

rules.explanation: NCCP adjuvant pathway excludes neoadjuvant chemotherapy, neoadjuvant/adjuvant radiation and prior EGFR inhibitor therapy; specialist protocol review is required.

action.message: Without adjuvant chemotherapy NCCP starts osimertinib within 10 weeks of complete resection.

rules.explanation: Without adjuvant chemotherapy NCCP starts osimertinib within 10 weeks of complete resection.

action.message: Do not start adjuvant osimertinib before adjuvant chemotherapy is complete. NCCP permits up to four platinum-doublet cycles.

rules.explanation: Do not start adjuvant osimertinib before adjuvant chemotherapy is complete. NCCP permits up to four platinum-doublet cycles.

action.message: After adjuvant chemotherapy, start no sooner than two and no later than ten weeks after its final dose.

rules.explanation: After adjuvant chemotherapy, start no sooner than two and no later than ten weeks after its final dose.

action.message: At three years review planned completion. Treatment beyond three years was not studied; do not extrapolate the advanced continuous-duration plan.

rules.explanation: At three years review planned completion. Treatment beyond three years was not studied; do not extrapolate the advanced continuous-duration plan.

action.message: Interrupt osimertinib and urgently investigate possible ILD/pneumonitis. A symptom grade does not confirm the diagnosis; if confirmed use the permanent-stop pathway.

rules.explanation: Interrupt osimertinib and urgently investigate possible ILD/pneumonitis. A symptom grade does not confirm the diagnosis; if confirmed use the permanent-stop pathway.

action.message: NCCP permanently discontinues diagnosed ILD/pneumonitis, including grade 1. EMA section 4.4 mentions individual benefit/risk consideration for reintroduction; no automatic rechallenge is encoded.

action.message: Interrupt and urgently assess suspected SJS/TEN. Do not manage blistering or mucosal involvement as ordinary acneiform rash.

rules.explanation: Interrupt and urgently assess suspected SJS/TEN. Do not manage blistering or mucosal involvement as ordinary acneiform rash.

action.message: Permanently discontinue osimertinib for confirmed SJS or TEN.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue osimertinib for confirmed SJS or TEN.

action.message: Urgent blood-count/clinical assessment; NCCP advises close monitoring and consideration of interruption or discontinuation for suspected aplastic anaemia.

action.message: Permanently discontinue osimertinib for confirmed aplastic anaemia.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue osimertinib for confirmed aplastic anaemia.

action.message: QTc above 500 ms needs urgent review and repeat ECG. Confirm whether >500 ms occurred on at least two separate ECGs; a single value does not establish the source restart pathway.

rules.explanation: QTc above 500 ms needs urgent review and repeat ECG. Confirm whether >500 ms occurred on at least two separate ECGs; a single value does not establish the source restart pathway.

action.message: Withhold for QTc >500 ms on at least two separate ECGs. Resume only after QTc <481 ms, or recovery to baseline if baseline ≥481 ms; source restart is 40 mg once daily, subject to Consultant authorisation.

rules.explanation: Withhold for QTc >500 ms on at least two separate ECGs. Resume only after QTc <481 ms, or recovery to baseline if baseline ≥481 ms; source restart is 40 mg once daily, subject to Consultant authorisation.

action.message: Permanently discontinue for QTc prolongation with signs/symptoms of serious arrhythmia, including torsade de pointes or polymorphic ventricular tachycardia.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue for QTc prolongation with signs/symptoms of serious arrhythmia, including torsade de pointes or polymorphic ventricular tachycardia.

action.message: Source QTc recovery criterion is met; Consultant must review all other limitations before authorising the 40 mg once-daily restart. No automatic clearance.

action.message: QTc >470 ms was a clinical-trial exclusion; review baseline risk, interacting drugs and electrolytes. This is not the >500 ms two-ECG treatment-hold rule.

action.message: Assess cardiac symptoms and LVEF promptly. NCCP/EMA monotherapy sources advise cardiac monitoring but do not define an automatic LVEF percentage dose-reduction rule.

action.message: Withhold osimertinib for up to three weeks for a grade ≥3 other adverse reaction. Reassess recovery to grade 0–2 and the separate serious-syndrome pathways before any restart.

rules.explanation: Withhold osimertinib for up to three weeks for a grade ≥3 other adverse reaction. Reassess recovery to grade 0–2 and the separate serious-syndrome pathways before any restart.

action.message: Severe hepatic / Child-Pugh C: NCCP says 50% of original dose may be considered, but EMA 4.2 says use is not recommended because safety/efficacy are unestablished. Reconcile with Consultant and pharmacy; do not calculate an automatic 40 mg dose.

action.message: Abnormal liver results require baseline/trend, clinical hepatic assessment and event-specific toxicity grading. No NCCP osimertinib automatic ALT >5 × ULN hold rule is specified; do not infer drug hepatitis or Child-Pugh C from isolated results.

action.message: Avoid strong CYP3A inducers where possible; moderate inducers also need caution. NCCP provides no dose adjustment to overcome an interaction.

action.message: Review QT-prolonging medicines and electrolyte risk, obtain ECG/electrolytes as indicated, and choose supportive medicines individually.

action.message: Prompt ophthalmology referral for possible keratitis; assess eye symptoms rather than assign an automatic systemic dose reduction.

action.message: After a documented QTc hold, the source recovery criterion is not met. Continue withholding and repeat cardiac review; no restart is authorised.

rules.explanation: After a documented QTc hold, the source recovery criterion is not met. Continue withholding and repeat cardiac review; no restart is authorised.

eligibility: NCCP00353a/b/c indication-specific molecular and stage criteria; validated EGFR testing.
Adjuvant start within 10 weeks of resection without chemotherapy; if chemotherapy used, complete at most four platinum-doublet cycles and start 2–10 weeks after final dose.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity, congenital long QT syndrome, pregnancy or breastfeeding.
For adjuvant: neoadjuvant/adjuvant radiation, neoadjuvant chemotherapy or prior EGFR inhibitor therapy.

baseline: Validated EGFR testing; use resected tumour tissue for adjuvant indication.
FBC, liver, renal and bone profile; ECG; LVEF if clinically indicated.
regular: FBC, liver, renal and bone profile.
NCCP ECG at baseline and cycle 2, then cycle 3+ if indicated; this is a review cadence, not a cyclic drug schedule. Confirm local cycle-2 review date.
LVEF if clinically indicated; additional ECG/electrolytes for cardiac/QT risks.
disease: According to Consultant treatment plan; no fixed imaging interval encoded.

dose_modifications.principle: All modifications discussed with Consultant; standard reduction is 40 mg once daily. No arithmetic compounding of limitations.
conflicts: Severe hepatic: NCCP consideration of 50% versus EMA not recommended.
Renal/dialysis: NCCP no expected adjustment versus EMA evidence gap and caution.
NCCP CTCAE v4.0 versus EMA v5.0; this module retains NCCP grading.
NCCP confirmed ILD permanent discontinuation versus EMA section 4.4 exceptional benefit/risk reintroduction wording; no automatic rechallenge.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP00353 v5 minimal-to-low; individual oral rescue support, with QT/interaction review. NCIS V8 parenteral rows are not copied.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT

treatment_phases.label: Daily osimertinib monotherapy
treatment_phases.duration_note: No chemotherapy cycle or rest week. Adjuvant treatment has a three-year studied limit; advanced treatment continues according to benefit and tolerability.

use_with_caution: Previous ILD, drug-induced ILD, steroid-treated radiation pneumonitis or active ILD were clinical-study exclusions; assess before treatment.
Baseline QTc >470 ms was a trial exclusion; congenital long QT is a separate NCCP exclusion.
Consider baseline and ongoing LVEF assessment with cardiac risk factors, relevant conditions or symptoms.
NCCP advises closer monitoring for age >65 years or body weight <50 kg; EMA does not require dose adjustment solely for age or weight.
